p1_root_cause: MAIWMCPClient raised a plain MCPToolError for every is_error result; classify_write_failure mapped it to FAILED/MCP_TOOL_ERROR/physical_mutation_occurred=False, so the target was unblocked, reconciliation refused and a retry wrote twice. The shipped Postgres adapter ran each logical write as non-transactional statements and turned any exception into is_error.
